product.description: Bătrânul și inofensivul paroh Babbington moare subit, la petrecerea organizată de un celebru actor, după ce bea un cocktail care nu conține nici o urmă de otravă. Nici măcar Hercule Poirot, aflat printre invitați, nu are vreo suspiciune legată de acest deces. Dar când un prieten al aceluiași actor moare în circumstanțe asemănătoare, nu mai este nici o îndoială că e vorba de niște asasinate. Lipsa unor motive îl pune însă în încurcătură pe Poirot. Va trebui să aibă loc o a treia crimă pentru ca detectivul să descopere o cinică punere în scenă, al cărei unic scop este să deturneze atenția anchetatorilor...

Step into a world of suspense and deduction with *Tragedy in Three Acts*, an engrossing piece of fiction that will challenge your wits. From the renowned brand Litera, this mystery novel plunges readers into a seemingly perfect gathering where nothingâor everythingâis what it appears to be. If you love classic detective stories and complex whodunits, this book is for you.

## The Mystery Unfolds: A Dinner Party of Death

The narrative begins with the sudden demise of Babbington, an old and harmless gentleman. His death occurs during a lavish party hosted by a celebrated actor, following him drinking what appears to be a non-poisonous cocktail. Remarkably, even Hercule Poirot, who is among the guests, finds no immediate suspicion regarding this first tragic passing.

## When Assassination Takes Center Stage

The initial incident proves merely the prelude. The mystery escalates when the actor's friend dies under equally suspicious circumstances. It soon becomes impossible to ignore: these deaths are deliberate assassinations. However, the lack of clear motive throws Poirot into intellectual disarray. Can a detective solve crimes when the perpetrators have carefully masked their intentions?

The ultimate revelation requires a third act. The investigation must proceed until Poirot uncovers a cynical and elaborate setupâa brilliant diversion designed solely to distract and confuse all potential investigators. *Tragedy in Three Acts* is a masterful puzzle of deduction, ensuring that every page keeps you guessing until the final, satisfying reveal.
